data.one_liner: Advanced error handler and logger package for Flutter and Dart apps.
data.what_it_does: Talker provides logging, error and exception handling, app monitoring, log history, report sharing, and custom logs for Flutter and Dart. It offers built-in support for network calls and state management libraries through companion packages.
use_when: You need structured logging and error handling across your Flutter or Dart app
You want a UI screen to monitor logs and errors directly on the device
You need to catch, share, and report exceptions and app actions
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-line console logger without history or reporting
You are building a lightweight CLI utility where a heavy error monitoring toolkit is unnecessary
strengths: Comprehensive log history and report sharing capabilities
Extensive integrations for Dio, HTTP, BLoC, Riverpod, Chopper, and gRPC
Customizable log formats, colors, and titles
weaknesses: Requires using multiple companion packages (like talker_flutter, talker_dio_logger) for full feature sets across the ecosystem
Can add overhead if only basic print statements are needed
data.setup_notes: Simply add talker to your pubspec.yaml and instantiate Talker().

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick logger if you only need a simple, zero-setup pretty console logger without history tracking or advanced monitoring UI features.

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick sentry if your primary goal is cloud-based crash reporting rather than local debugging and custom log filtering.
